issue.title: `Maximum recursive updates exceeded`: when accessing a responsive variable in `onScopeDispose`

repository.name: core
repository.description: 🖖 Vue.js is a progressive, incrementally-adoptable JavaScript framework for building UI on the web.

issue.body:
### Vue version

3.2.37

### Link to minimal reproduction

https://stackblitz.com/edit/vitejs-vite-t5bbox?file=src/HelloWorld.vue

### Steps to reproduce

- open the browser's console
- update any code in `HelloWorld.vue`, for example: `console.log('watch', element)` => `console.log('test', element)`
- observe the console logs


### What is expected?

this component will be rendered only once

### What is actually happening?

 [Vue warn]: Maximum recursive updates exceeded in component <App>. This means you have a reactive effect that is mutating its own dependencies and thus recursively triggering itself. Possible sources include component template, render function, updated hook or watcher source function.
       
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/25052421/186356534-ec9d30fd-d0fc-4126-ad20-4cf8f9d362b7.png)


### System Info

_No response_

### Any additional comments?

I also ran some other tests, such as commenting out line 11 of `HelloWorld.vue` or using `onUnmounted` instead of `onScopeDispose`, did not produce this warning.

issue.title: [Bug Report][3.1.4] v-overlay results in [Vue warn]: Maximum recursive updates exceeded in component

labels.name: T: bug
labels.description: Functionality that does not work as intended/expected

issue.body:
### Environment
**Vuetify Version:** 3.1.4
**Vue Version:** 3.2.45
**Browsers:** Chrome 109.0.0.0
**OS:** Mac OS 10.15.7

### Steps to reproduce
1. npm install
2. npm run dev
3. Open Browser and click button to open dialog
4. Open Browser Dev-Tools
5. Change the value of the lines 67 or 68 in the components/base/project/MemberDialog.vue
6. Observe the warnings in the command line of the dev tools

### Expected Behavior
No warning should show and the component should refresh directly

### Actual Behavior
A warning shows, telling the developer, that the  "Maximum recursive updates exceeded" with the stack trace sometimes showing the problem being the watchEffect in the `useScrollStrategies` function in the VOverlay directory.
Additionally the warning `[Vue warn] cannot run an inactive effect scope.` is shown 100 times.

The reproduction example refreshes realtivly quickly, but once the dialog gets more and complex content, the refresh and the time until the warnings appear and the page is no longer freezed, can be up to a minute.

### Reproduction Link
[https://github.com/Hendrik-Mueller-Overzone/voverlay-max-recursive-updates](https://github.com/Hendrik-Mueller-Overzone/voverlay-max-recursive-updates)

### Other comments
This may relate to #16569

Screenshot showing warnings:
